data.summary: The validation stage processed 1,000 rows with train/test/oot splits, scored the refit, and identified one detector firing. The challenger model achieved 0.607 versus champion 0.998, with slice search worst 0.991. High‑severity finding F‑02 indicates the challenger was trained and assessed on the same rows.
reasons: High‑severity finding F‑02: challenger trained and assessed on same data, risking overfitting.
Medium‑severity findings F‑01 and F‑03 raise concerns about approval‑rate disparity and direct use of protected attributes.
Only one detector fired, but the overall performance gap suggests further review.
